name: Asset Flow
description: AssetFlow is an ERP-style asset and resource management platform covering the full lifecycle - registration, allocation, transfers, and maintenance - with dashboard KPIs, resource booking with conflict validation, a Kanban-based maintenance workflow, structured audit cycles, reporting, notifications, activity logs, and role-based access across Admin, Asset Manager, Department Head, and Employee roles.
features: Dashboard KPIs for asset status, active bookings, pending transfers, and overdue returns
Asset lifecycle management from registration through allocation, maintenance, audits, and disposal
Calendar-based resource booking with automatic overlap validation
Maintenance Kanban board with automatic asset status updates
Structured audit cycles with discrepancy reports
Granular RBAC for Admin, Asset Manager, Department Head, and Employee roles
